places.name: New Orleans 1815 (Place d'Armes / Jackson Square)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim 'Jackson Square' 29.95747,-90.06295; Place d'Armes = Jackson Square (HNOC)
places.note: 1815 city = the French Quarter grid; Jackson HQ in town 1-23 Dec at Maspero/Rue Royale (not mapped)

places.name: Chalmette Monument
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim 29.94245,-89.99414
places.note: Stands BEHIND (west of) the American line; 100 ft obelisk completed 1908

places.name: Chalmette Battlefield (park centre)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim 29.94327,-89.99031; Wikipedia battle infobox 29.9425,-89.9908
places.note: Wikipedia 'Battle of New Orleans' infobox 29°56'33"N 89°59'27"W

places.name: Chalmette National Cemetery
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
places.note: Lies on the British side (downriver) of the line, on old Chalmette plantation ground

places.name: Line Jackson river end (Rodriguez Canal, levee end)
places.src: geometry estimated by Claude from Latour 1816 pp.146-152 (battery spacing in yards, line 815 toises) anchored to OSM/Wikipedia Chalmette points; NOT surveyed
places.note: Battery 1 stood on the road 70 ft from the river bank (Latour p.147). The 1815 river bank lay closer than the modern levee; aggregation since 1815 (batture growth) moved the water edge. GEOREGISTER against Latour Atlas Plate 7 and the NPS Chalmette GIS before shot design.

places.name: Line Jackson elbow (end of straight river-to-wood stretch, after Battery 8)
places.src: geometry estimated by Claude from Latour 1816 pp.146-152 (battery spacing in yards, line 815 toises) anchored to OSM/Wikipedia Chalmette points; NOT surveyed
places.note: Latour p.149: after No.8 'the line formed a receding elbow'

places.name: Line Jackson swamp end (cypress swamp, Coffee's left)
places.src: geometry estimated by Claude from Latour 1816 pp.146-152 (battery spacing in yards, line 815 toises) anchored to OSM/Wikipedia Chalmette points; NOT surveyed
places.note: Total line 815 toises = ~1.59 km (Latour p.147); NPS: swamp leg turned back at right angle (Lafitte's advice)

places.name: Macarty house (Jackson HQ, 24 Dec-Jan)
places.src: Estimate: upriver (west) of the canal, near the river road behind the line's river end; modern Malus-Beauregard House stands near the site (NPS Chalmette). Latour p.158
places.note: Shelled 1 Jan and 8 Jan; Wikipedia says 'completely destroyed' 1 Jan, Latour says only four or five pillars knocked down on 8 Jan - sources differ

places.name: Chalmette plantation house (British battery / ruins)
places.src: Estimate: immediately downriver of Rodriguez Canal (canal = boundary Macarty/Chalmette, NPS hh29i)
places.note: Buildings blown up by Americans evening 27 Dec (NPS hh29i); British battery behind its ruins 1 Jan and 8 Jan (Latour p.158)

places.name: Bienvenu plantation
places.src: Estimate: order Macarty-Chalmette-Bienvenu-De la Ronde-Lacoste-Villere (Latour pp.87-98)
places.note: Boundary Bienvenu/De la Ronde is where Latour met fleeing planters 23 Dec

places.name: De la Ronde plantation (house; British hospital later)
places.src: Estimate; NPS hh29h says De la Ronde mansion used as British hospital; Jackson's forces reached 'De La Ronde Oaks' at nightfall 23 Dec
places.note: Coffee circled behind it to reach the British flank

places.name: Night-battle centre (De la Ronde / Lacoste boundary)
places.src: Estimate: Latour p.113 'about two miles behind the field of battle' to the Rodriguez Canal; NPS hh29i '2 miles from the scene of the Night Battle and 6 miles from the centre of New Orleans'
places.note: British outposts on Lacoste/De la Ronde boundary road

places.name: Lacoste plantation (Keane's camp 23 Dec)
places.src: Estimate; Wikipedia: Keane encamped at Lacoste's; Latour: camp straddled Villere and Lacoste
places.note: 85th was posted at Lacoste's negro huts

places.name: Villere plantation house (British HQ 23 Dec-19 Jan)
places.src: Estimate: ~9 mi below the city (Latour p.95; Remini 1999), ~3 mi downriver of Rodriguez Canal; NPS hh29h: Villere house British HQ 23 Dec-19 Jan
places.note: Gabriel Villere escaped through a window ~11:30 a.m. 23 Dec (Latour p.87)

places.name: Villere canal head (British landing, 4 a.m. 23 Dec)
places.src: Estimate: Latour p.86-87 canal mouth ~1 mile to the wood + ~2 miles to the river = ~3 mi inland (~4.8 km) from Villere house
places.note: Boats ended here; troops marched ~6 hours to the river

places.name: USS Carolina anchorage 23 Dec (Villere batture)
places.src: Latour p.95: anchored 'on the brink of Villere's batture opposite the centre of the British encampment, within musket-shot'; opened 7:30 p.m.
places.note: Sunk by British hot shot 27 Dec (NPS hh29i; Wikipedia)

places.name: Marine Battery (Patterson, west bank, opposite line)
places.src: Latour App. p.lx Patterson letter 'Marine battery, five miles below New Orleans'; west-bank river bank opposite Macarty/Chalmette
places.note: Mounted 24-pdrs and 12-pdrs; overrun by Thornton's force 8 Jan ~10 a.m. window

places.name: Morgan's forward west-bank position
places.src: Low confidence. Latour/Reilly: Morgan split ~700 men between two positions a mile apart; Thornton landed ~1,000 yd below the intended point (Wikipedia)
places.note: Verify on Latour Atlas Plate 7; Boisgervais canal line (2nd west-bank line) was 3 mi from the city (Latour p.124)

places.name: Line Dupre / Montreuil (second line, Gentilly-Plaine road)
places.src: Latour App. & Wikipedia: Americans built 3 defence lines; forward line at Rodriguez Canal. Exact Dupre/Montreuil coordinates NOT verified in this pass
places.note: NOT MAPPED - use Latour Plate 5/7

places.name: English Turn (Mississippi bend below the city)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
places.note: Naturally narrow river bend; Louisiana ship retreated upriver, Dec 27-28

places.name: Fort St. Philip (east bank, below English Turn)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim 29.36261,-89.46535 (Fort Jackson on west bank 29.3571,-89.4547)
places.note: Bombarded 9-18 Jan 1815 by two bomb vessels, 4 mortars

places.name: Fort Petites Coquilles (Rigolets) / Fort Pike site
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Fort Pike 30.16532,-89.73939; Rigolets Wikipedia 30.1544,-89.6253
places.note: Fort Pike built 1819 to replace the old fort; 1815 Fort Petites Coquilles was a small work at the Rigolets

places.name: Chef Menteur (road and pass, Fort Macomb site)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Fort Macomb
places.note: Jackson guarded Chef Menteur Road (Daughan); British option 2 not taken

places.name: Bayou Bienvenue (modern bayou, mid-course)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim; Wikipedia 29.9996,-89.8611
places.note: 1815 course and Lake Borgne shoreline differ (coast has since eroded/inundated)

places.name: Bayou Bienvenue mouth on Lake Borgne / Fisherman's village (approx)
places.src: LOW CONFIDENCE estimate. Wikipedia: British went 'to Bayou Bienvenue, then Bayou Mazant and the Villere Canal'; Latour: Fishermen's Village at the bayou head
places.note: Fisherman's village (Spanish fishermen) captured/forced into British service 22 Dec; verify on Latour Plate 3

places.name: Lake Borgne gunboat action site (Malheureux Island - Point Claire channel)
places.src: Wikipedia Battle of Lake Borgne infobox 30°09'52"N 89°26'14"W = 30.1644,-89.4372; text: gunboats in line abreast between Malheureux Island and Point Claire
places.note: Final stand 14 Dec ~10:39-12:30

places.name: Pea Island (Isle aux Pois), Pearl River mouth
places.src: LOW CONFIDENCE. Wikipedia Lake Borgne: 'at the mouth of the Pearl River, due north of St Malo'; ~30 mi east of New Orleans (Brown 1969)
places.note: British staging; 1,600 men ferried 6 days/nights, ~10 h per transit (Brown 1969)

places.name: Cat Island (fleet anchorage)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Cat Island, Harrison Co., MS
places.note: Troopship anchorage, ~60 miles from Pea Island/Bayou Bienvenue (Wikipedia)

places.name: Ship Island (fleet anchorage)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim
places.note: Cochrane's fleet anchored between Ship and Cat Islands

places.name: Fort Bowyer (Mobile Point; modern Fort Morgan)
places.src: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Fort Morgan
places.note: British captured 12 Feb 1815 (Wikipedia)

places.name: Pensacola (Jackson's attack 7-9 Nov 1814)
places.src: Wikipedia Battle of Pensacola (1814) 30.4107,-87.2112

lines.name: Line Jackson (Rodriguez Canal rampart), river to elbow
lines.src: geometry estimated by Claude from Latour 1816 pp.146-152 (battery spacing in yards, line 815 toises) anchored to OSM/Wikipedia Chalmette points; NOT surveyed

lines.name: Line Jackson swamp leg (receding elbow into cypress swamp)
lines.src: geometry estimated by Claude from Latour 1816 pp.146-152 (battery spacing in yards, line 815 toises) anchored to OSM/Wikipedia Chalmette points; NOT surveyed

lines.name: British advance redoubt/battery line ~800 yd (730 m) in front of Line Jackson
lines.src: Wikipedia (Hughes & Brodine p.1004: ~800 yd; other sources 500-880 yd); estimate

lines.name: Mississippi river road / levee (east bank, 1815 approx, upriver->downriver)
lines.src: Estimate, bearing ~80 deg from OSM Chalmette points; river bends downstream

lines.name: British route 23 Dec: Villere canal head -> wood -> Villere house
lines.src: Latour pp.86-87: 1 mile canal mouth to wood, ~2 miles wood to river

lines.name: Jackson's 23 Dec approach (city -> De la Ronde oaks)
lines.src: NPS hh29h; Latour pp.88-97; 'Old French Quarter' to De la Ronde oaks by nightfall; geometry estimated

lines.name: Coffee's flank march 23 Dec (behind De la Ronde, into Lacoste/Villere)
lines.src: Latour pp.97-99; NPS hh29h: Coffee circled left behind De la Ronde plantation guided by Col. de la Ronde; estimate

lines.name: Gibbs main column 8 Jan (British right, along wood edge toward Batteries 7-8/Carroll)
lines.src: Latour pp.154-155; Wikipedia; Reilly; start ~650 yd from line (Reilly p.286); estimate

lines.name: Keane column 8 Jan (centre/river road, then 93rd obliqued right)
lines.src: Wikipedia: 93rd ordered to leave river column and cross field to join main force; Keane wounded crossing

lines.name: Rennie column 8 Jan (river bank to advanced American redoubt)
lines.src: Latour p.157-158; NPS hh29m: redoubt taken, Rennie killed

lines.name: Thornton west-bank advance 8 Jan
lines.src: LOW CONFIDENCE sketch from Wikipedia/Thornton despatch (landed ~1,000 yd below target, 4 miles from battery at dawn per Gleig); verify on Latour Plate 7
